topic: Data file updates and processing status
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging a data reporting process. [me] tested an updated `curl` command to submit report data, confirming the script appeared functional. After identifying and pushing a fix for a second issue, the team agreed to run the job/jobbook.

[p1] suggested notifying external parties that the data files had been corrected and should no longer be processed by them, to prevent potential errors from their handling of the updated files.
decisions: Run the reporting job after implementing the fix.
action_items: [p1] to notify external parties that data files have been corrected and should stop processing them.
